Global arguments:
	<vmx location>		(required for commands working with VMs)
	    Location of the vmx file to work with. Can be the first or last argument on the command line.
	--verbose
	    Enable verbose logging.
	-h, --help
	    Display the help information
Module:
	Disk
	    Module to perform disk operations.
Arguments available to module "Disk":
	Create
	    Create Disk Files.
        e.g Disk Create -f myVirtualDisk.vmdk -a ide -s 1000MB -t 0
	Branch
	    Create a new disk branch based on the current VM state.
	BranchCancel
	    Request that a running branch operation be canceled.
	ConnectionControl
	    Alter the connection state of the specified device.

Connect or disconnect the specified device. If the device is already
in the requested state no error will occur. Any change will be
immediate.c

Altering the connection state via this routine does not affect or
control how the device connects upon power on. Use SetStartConnected
for that.

The device must be present (active in the VM) or an error will occur.
	ConvertAllocType
	    Convert the allocation type of the entire disk.
	ConvertAllocTypeCancel
	    Request that a running convert allocation type operation be canceled.
	Extend
	    Extend the specified virtual disk..
	IsPresent
	    Determine if the specified device is present.
	Move
	    Move the specified device from one "location" to another. The fromDeviceLabel must exist, the toDeviceLabel must not.
	Purge
	    Purge the specified device.
	query
	    Query the state of disks inside virtual machine.
	SetAllowGuestControl
	    This attribute controls the ability of a guest OS to access and control the specified device.
	SetBackingInfo
	    Set the backing object attributes of the specified device.
	SetBandwidthCap
	    This attribute controls the bandwidth cap attribute of the specified disk. Units are bytes per second.
	SetCbrcCacheEnabled

	SetCtkEnabled

	SetDigest
